## Appearance

Tibby Tulk is styled to the absolute limit, featuring a pompadour and an abundance of frills.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## Personality

Tibby Tulk is an attention-seeking individual who habitually arrives late to make a striking impression. She displays an unkind and jealous disposition, frequently making disparaging remarks about Julia in her absence and taking delight when others find fault with her.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## Traits

- jealous (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)</sub>
- theatrically attention-seeking (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)</sub>
- unkind (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)</sub>
